description.message: Islamic prayer times with notifications and automatic media pause in Firefox tabs. Offline, private, English & العربية.

method_7.message: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran

method_12.message: Union des Organisations Islamiques de France

method_14.message: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia

popup_nextPrayerNone.message: No computable prayer time for this location

notify_title.message: It is now time for {prayer} prayer

notify_body_media.message: {time} — media in Firefox tabs has been paused (Tcalm)

notify_testBody.message: If you can read this, the notification was displayed.

options_notifyTestOk.message: The notification appeared on screen — prayer notifications are working.

options_notifyTestSuppressed.message: The notification was created but the system did not display it. Allow Firefox to show notifications in your OS notification settings, turn off Focus Assist / Do Not Disturb, then try again.

options_notifyTestUnknown.message: The notification was created. This browser cannot confirm on-screen display — watch for it now.

options_notifyOsHint.message: The notification permission is required by this extension (granted automatically at install — it is not optional). If notifications still never appear despite a passing test: make sure your OS lets Firefox show notifications, Do-Not-Disturb is off, and Firefox-level notification settings allow them.

options_alertWindowModeHint.message: A Tcalm window no OS setting can block — Fallback shows it only when the banner fails. Default: Never.

options_alertWindowSecondsHint.message: The window closes itself after this delay; click it, press the × button, or hit Esc to close it immediately.

options_toastTestOpened.message: The on-screen alert window opened — you should see it right now. This is the fallback channel that cannot fail.

options_toastTestDisabled.message: The alert window is disabled in settings (mode: never).

options_toastTestFailed.message: The alert window could not be opened — send this log with your report.

options_timeFormatHint.message: Shown in the popup and in notifications (12-hour is the default).

options_location_autoHint.message: Automatic mode asks Firefox for your position only when you press the button. Your coordinates never leave the extension except for the optional IP lookup below.

options_gpsDenied.message: Permission denied — enable location for this site in Firefox settings.

options_ipHint.message: Optional: sends your IP address to the public service ipwho.is to estimate city and timezone. Nothing is sent otherwise.

options_ipFailed.message: IP lookup failed or was not authorized.

options_worldHint.message: Choose from {countries} countries and {cities} cities worldwide — coordinates and timezone fill in automatically as you pick.

options_coordsHint.message: Coordinates drive the calculation; city and country are labels only.

options_methodHint.message: Default is the Egyptian General Authority of Survey, as in Tcalm.

options_highLat_unresolved.message: No adjustment (may be unavailable at extreme latitudes)

options_highLatHint.message: Applies near polar latitudes where the sun does not reach the Fajr/Isha angles.

options_hijriHint.message: Shifts the Hijri date shown in the popup if your local calendar differs.

options_minutesBeforeHint.message: 0 = notify at prayer time only (Tcalm behavior).

options_soundHint.message: Where Firefox allows audio from the background page.

options_mediaSitesHint.message: Host names like youtube.com or music.youtube.com. Applies only in allowlist mode.

options_mediaInvalidSite.message: Enter a plain host name such as “youtube.com”.

options_mediaDurationHint.message: 0 = media stays paused until you press play again yourself (Tcalm default). Above 0: media stays paused for the duration, then Tcalm resumes only what it paused itself.

options_mediaGranted.message: Granted — Tcalm can pause media in Firefox tabs.

options_mediaNotGranted.message: Not granted — Tcalm cannot pause media until you grant site access. You can revoke it anytime in Firefox Add-ons settings.

options_mediaPermissionMissing.message: ⚠ Media pause needs the site access permission first — grant it below, then test again.

options_mediaLimitation.message: Note: a Firefox extension can pause media playing inside Firefox tabs — including custom players that keep their element off-page (SoundCloud) and Web Audio sites. It cannot pause desktop apps like Spotify or VLC — that requires Tcalm’s desktop daemon.

options_mediaResumeNote.message: Resume restores the media paused by the most recent pause event — older paused tabs stay paused until you play them yourself. Pausing targets only tabs that are playing sound (or are on screen), so a large tab count no longer slows it down.

options_mediaPlatforms.message: Pauses any site playing media in a Firefox tab — YouTube, Netflix, Spotify, Apple Music, Anghami, Deezer, Shahid, SoundCloud and every other player, including custom ones that keep their audio element off-page. During a hold (duration > 0), restarted players are re-paused within seconds.

options_testNoMedia.message: No playing media found — {candidates} tab(s) with sound or on-screen activity checked, {unreachable} not reachable. Open a tab with audio or video playing, then try again.

options_testResistant.message: Media on {hosts} resisted pausing — reload that tab once, then test again.

options_testSinglePause.message: stays paused until you press play

options_mediaResumed.message: Resumed {count} item(s) from the last pause.

options_mediaNothingToResume.message: The last pause left nothing waiting to resume.

options_mediaNoResponse.message: Background script did not respond — please reload this page.

onboarding_tagline.message: Calm prayer times, right inside Firefox

onboarding_intro.message: Tcalm shows prayer times, notifies you at prayer time, and can automatically pause playing media in your Firefox tabs. Everything is computed locally — your data never leaves your device.

onboarding_featTimesNote.message: Five daily prayer times computed on your device, with a banner and a sound at prayer time.

onboarding_featMediaNote.message: Audio and video playing in your Firefox tabs goes quiet for the prayer — and comes back afterwards.

onboarding_featPrivacyNote.message: No accounts, no tracking, no data collection. Times are computed locally, always.

onboarding_platformsNote.message: …and any other site that plays audio or video in a Firefox tab.

onboarding_locationTitle.message: Where should prayer times be calculated?

onboarding_locationNote.message: The calculation method follows your country’s convention. You can change all of this anytime in settings.

onboarding_locationSaved.message: Location saved — times will update in a moment.

onboarding_permsIntro.message: These settings can be changed anytime from the Tcalm settings page.

onboarding_permMediaNote.message: Optional — lets Tcalm pause video/audio playing in Firefox tabs. Needs access to all sites.

onboarding_permIpNote.message: Optional — one request to ipwho.is to estimate your city when you press the button. Nothing is sent otherwise.

onboarding_grantedNote.message: Media pause and IP location are ready. You can turn each feature on or off in settings.

onboarding_privacy.message: Private by design: no accounts, no tracking, no data collection. See Firefox’s permission description for the exact scope.

onboarding_revokedNote.message: Permissions were revoked — press the button to enable them again.

diag_hint.message: Recent internal events, kept only on this device and auto-deleted after 7 days, so the log can never affect storage size or performance. If anything misbehaves, press “Copy for support” and send the log with your report.

diag_empty.message: No events recorded — Tcalm has not reported any errors.

diag_summary.message: Showing {shown} of {total} events — auto-deleted after 7 days

options_resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults?

options_importInvalid.message: The selected file is not a valid Tcalm settings export.

about_intro.message: This browser extension is inspired by and builds on the idea of Tcalm, an open-source desktop project: calm, offline prayer-time reminders with automatic media pause.

about_credit.message: Many thanks to the author of the original Tcalm project for the wonderful idea.

about_author.message: Browser version developed by Mohamed Naseem.
